principle: Stores source-cited numerical experimental facts only; no copyrighted source passages.

source.title: Ceftriaxone, an FDA-approved cephalosporin antibiotic, suppresses lung cancer growth by targeting Aurora B.

records.effect_description: Aurora B kinase-panel activity was approximately 45% of control at the tested ceftriaxone concentration.
A high-concentration cellular phenotype was reported in lung-cancer cell experiments.

limitations: The 100 uM result is a single-concentration kinase-panel observation, not an IC50.
The 500 uM cellular result is substantially higher than the biochemical test concentration.
These data do not establish efficacy in MVA or in the patient's genotype.
